meaning.en: To be in distress but unable to tell anyone about it.
meaning.zh: 有苦衷或苦痛，却不能说出来。

equivalents: be unable to voice one's pain

examples.zh: 他被人冤枉，有苦难言。
examples.en: He was wrongly blamed and could say nothing in his defence.

examples.zh: 婆媳之间的矛盾，让她有苦难言。
examples.en: The friction with her mother-in-law was something she could not talk about.

examples.zh: 员工们对不合理的加班有苦难言。
examples.en: The staff suffer in silence under the unreasonable overtime.

usage.en: Predicate; often follows a clause about being wronged.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，前面常有受委屈的分句。

meaning.en: To help with all one's strength (a polite way to thank or ask someone).
meaning.zh: 用很大的力量帮助，多用于感谢或请求别人。

examples.zh: 感谢各位朋友的鼎力相助。
examples.en: Thank you all, my friends, for your generous support.

examples.zh: 这次活动得到了多家企业的鼎力相助。
examples.en: The event received strong backing from many companies.

examples.zh: 若蒙鼎力相助，我们将不胜感激。
examples.en: We would be most grateful for your generous help.

usage.en: Polite and formal; used of others' help, never of one's own.
usage.zh: 敬辞，用于他人的帮助，不用于自己。

meaning.en: Hard or impossible to reverse or make up for.
meaning.zh: 很难改变局面或弥补损失。

examples.zh: 事情已经造成了难以挽回的损失。
examples.en: The matter has caused irreparable losses.

examples.zh: 名誉一旦受损，便难以挽回。
examples.en: Once reputation is damaged, it is hard to recover.

examples.zh: 两人的关系已经难以挽回。
examples.en: The relationship between them is beyond saving.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive: 难以挽回的 + loss/consequence.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。

meaning.en: To leave one's post without permission.
meaning.zh: 没有得到允许，擅自离开工作岗位。

examples.zh: 值班护士擅离职守，造成了严重后果。
examples.en: The nurse on duty left her post without permission, with serious consequences.

examples.zh: 哨兵擅离职守要受到军纪处分。
examples.en: A sentry who deserts his post faces military discipline.

examples.zh: 员工不得擅离职守。
examples.en: Employees must not leave their posts without leave.

usage.en: Predicate; regulations and news.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，用于规章、新闻。

meaning.en: To drink the whole cup in a single gulp.
meaning.zh: 一口气把杯中的酒或饮料喝光。

examples.zh: 他端起酒杯，一饮而尽。
examples.en: He raised his glass and drained it in one go.

examples.zh: 她把那杯苦药一饮而尽。
examples.en: She downed the bitter medicine in a single gulp.

examples.zh: 干了这杯！大家一饮而尽。
examples.en: Bottoms up! Everyone emptied their glasses.

usage.en: Predicate, often right after 端起/举起.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常接在“端起”“举起”之后。

pinyin: bù shí rén jiān yān huǒ
literal: not · eat · human · world · cooked food

meaning.en: Detached from ordinary life, as if one lived beyond the mortal world; often said of someone naive about everyday matters.
meaning.zh: 不吃凡间的熟食，形容超凡脱俗，或不了解现实生活。

examples.zh: 她清冷淡雅，像不食人间烟火的仙子。
examples.en: She is cool and elegant, like a fairy who eats no mortal food.

examples.zh: 你别太天真，像个不食人间烟火的人。
examples.en: Don't be so naive, as if you had never lived in the real world.

examples.zh: 这位隐士过着不食人间烟火的生活。
examples.en: The hermit lived apart from the ordinary world.

usage.en: Usually negated verb phrase; can praise (ethereal) or criticise (out of touch).
usage.zh: 常作谓语，可褒可贬。

meaning.en: To be unflustered and at ease, especially under pressure.
meaning.zh: 形容沉着镇定，不慌不忙。

examples.zh: 大战在即，他依然气定神闲地喝茶。
examples.en: On the eve of the battle he was calmly sipping tea.

examples.zh: 面对记者的追问，她气定神闲。
examples.en: Faced with the reporters' questions, she stayed calm and composed.

examples.zh: 棋手气定神闲，落子如飞。
examples.en: The player, cool and collected, placed his stones swiftly.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial; positive.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语，褒义。

natural: with no one to rely on in old age

meaning.en: To have no one to depend on in old age.
meaning.zh: 年老了没有可以依靠的人。

equivalents: with no one to turn to in old age

examples.zh: 政府建起养老院，让孤寡老人不再老无所依。
examples.en: The government built care homes so that elderly people living alone are not left without support.

examples.zh: 他无儿无女，晚年老无所依。
examples.en: Childless, he had no one to rely on in his later years.

examples.zh: 老有所养，老无所依是社会要解决的问题。
examples.en: Making sure no old person is left without support is a problem society must solve.

usage.en: Predicate; contrasts with 老有所依.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，与“老有所依”相对。

meaning.en: Rough, steep and uneven (of paths and ground).
meaning.zh: 形容道路险峻、高低不平。

examples.zh: 山路崎岖不平，车子开得很慢。
examples.en: The mountain road was rough and bumpy, so the car went slowly.

examples.zh: 他走过一段崎岖不平的小路。
examples.en: He walked along a rugged little path.

examples.zh: 人生的道路崎岖不平，要有耐心。
examples.en: Life's road is uneven; be patient.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; also figurative.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，也可比喻。

natural: play and sing all kinds of music

meaning.en: Playing wind, bowed and plucked instruments and singing; all-round musical skills.
meaning.zh: 吹奏、拉弦、弹拨乐器和演唱，泛指各种文艺技能。

examples.zh: 他吹拉弹唱样样精通。
examples.en: He is skilled at every kind of music-making.

examples.zh: 村里的戏班吹拉弹唱，热闹极了。
examples.en: The village troupe played and sang, and it was very lively.

examples.zh: 退休后，爷爷参加了社区的吹拉弹唱队。
examples.en: After retiring, Grandpa joined the neighbourhood music group.

usage.en: Often with 样样精通 or describing folk performances.
usage.zh: 常与“样样精通”搭配，或形容民间文艺表演。

meaning.en: To be free to come and go as one pleases.
meaning.zh: 想来就来，想走就走，不受限制。

equivalents: come and go as you please

examples.zh: 这家图书馆开放式管理，读者来去自由。
examples.en: This library is open, and readers may come and go as they like.

examples.zh: 朋友之间来去自由，不必客气。
examples.en: Friends can come and go freely; no need to stand on ceremony.

examples.zh: 公司实行弹性工作制，员工来去自由。
examples.en: The company has flexible hours, so staff come and go freely.

usage.en: Predicate; 来去自如 is similar but stresses ease.
usage.zh: 多作谓语；“来去自如”更强调轻松熟练。

meaning.en: To give a loud, sharp shout.
meaning.zh: 大声喝叫一声。

examples.zh: 他大喝一声：“住手！”
examples.en: He shouted loudly, 'Stop!'

examples.zh: 武松大喝一声，抡起哨棒。
examples.en: Wu Song gave a roar and swung his staff.

examples.zh: 老师大喝一声，教室顿时安静下来。
examples.en: The teacher barked once and the classroom fell silent.

usage.en: Predicate, followed by what is said.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，后接所喝的话。

natural: may all your wishes come true

meaning.en: May whatever you wish for come true (a common greeting).
meaning.zh: 心里想的事都能成功，是常用的祝福语。

equivalents: may all your wishes come true
may your every wish be granted

examples.zh: 祝你新的一年万事如意，心想事成！
examples.en: Wishing you all the best in the new year, and may your wishes come true!

examples.zh: 生日快乐，愿你心想事成。
examples.en: Happy birthday; may all your wishes come true.

examples.zh: 贺卡上写着“身体健康，心想事成”。
examples.en: The card read 'Good health, and may all your wishes come true.'

usage.en: A set wish, usually paired with 万事如意 or 身体健康.
usage.zh: 常用祝福语，多与“万事如意、身体健康”连用。

meaning.en: Nearly sixty years old (花甲, a sixty-year cycle).
meaning.zh: 年纪接近六十岁。

examples.zh: 他年近花甲，依然坚持每天晨跑。
examples.en: Approaching sixty, he still goes for a run every morning.

examples.zh: 年近花甲的她决定重返校园。
examples.en: Nearing sixty, she decided to go back to school.

examples.zh: 老师傅年近花甲，手艺却丝毫不减。
examples.en: The old craftsman is nearing sixty, and his skill has not diminished.

usage.en: Predicate; 年逾花甲 means already past sixty, so is a different expression.
usage.zh: 多作谓语；“年逾花甲”指已超过六十岁，意思不同。

meaning.en: Having boundless prospects.
meaning.zh: 前景广阔，不可限量。

examples.zh: 这个年轻人聪明肯干，前途无量。
examples.en: This young man is clever and hard-working, with a bright future.

examples.zh: 她被誉为前途无量的新星。
examples.en: She is hailed as a rising star with a limitless future.

examples.zh: 人工智能行业前途无量。
examples.en: The AI industry has boundless prospects.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; praising someone's prospects.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，称赞前景。

meaning.en: Drifting and shifting, with no fixed place or course.
meaning.zh: 形容行踪或事物游移不定，难以捉摸。

examples.zh: 这个人行踪飘忽不定，很难找到。
examples.en: He is of no fixed whereabouts and hard to find.

examples.zh: 山间的雾气飘忽不定。
examples.en: The mist in the hills drifted unpredictably.

examples.zh: 她的目光飘忽不定，似乎心里有事。
examples.en: Her gaze kept shifting, as if something were on her mind.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。

meaning.en: Vivid in colour and rich in fragrance; lively, vivid and appealing.
meaning.zh: 形容色彩鲜活、香气浓郁，生动诱人。

examples.zh: 这幅画把江南水乡描绘得活色生香。
examples.en: The painting depicts the water towns south of the Yangtze in vivid, alluring colour.

examples.zh: 美食节上，一桌桌佳肴活色生香。
examples.en: At the food festival, table after table of dishes was colourful and fragrant.

examples.zh: 她的文字活色生香，读来如临其境。
examples.en: Her prose is lively and vivid; reading it, you feel you are there.

usage.en: Attributive or predicate; used of art, food and writing.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，形容艺术、美食、文字。

meaning.en: To seize every chance and use any means to gain personal advantage.
meaning.zh: 利用机会，不择手段谋取私利。

examples.zh: 他靠投机钻营爬上了高位。
examples.en: He climbed to a high position through opportunistic scheming.

examples.zh: 此类投机钻营的人，终究不会长久。
examples.en: People who scheme like this don't last in the end.

examples.zh: 别只想着投机钻营，要靠真本事吃饭。
examples.en: Don't think only of scheming; live by real ability.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; derogatory.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，贬义。

meaning.en: May wealth flow in abundantly (a common business or New Year wish).
meaning.zh: 财富的来源像滚滚流水，常用作祝福语。

examples.zh: 祝您新店开张，财源滚滚！
examples.en: Wishing you a successful opening, and may money pour in!

examples.zh: 春节贴上对联，愿来年财源滚滚。
examples.en: We put up couplets at the Spring Festival, hoping money rolls in next year.

examples.zh: 生意兴隆，财源滚滚，是商家最爱听的话。
examples.en: 'Thriving business, money rolling in' is what shopkeepers love to hear.

usage.en: Mostly a wish; also describes a booming business.
usage.zh: 多作祝福语，也形容生意兴旺。

meaning.en: To be unable to control one's own decisions or actions.
meaning.zh: 不能自己作主，不能控制自己的行为。

examples.zh: 在那个年代，婚姻大事往往不能自主。
examples.en: In that era, one often had no say in marriage.

examples.zh: 喝醉后他的行动不能自主。
examples.en: When drunk, he could not control what he did.

examples.zh: 她被家人安排好一切，处处不能自主。
examples.en: Her family arranged everything for her and she could decide nothing.

usage.en: Predicate or complement.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、补语。

meaning.en: To regain a youthful look and energy; to be full of new life.
meaning.zh: 重新显出青春活力。

examples.zh: 退休后她参加舞蹈队，整个人焕发青春。
examples.en: After retiring she joined a dance troupe and glowed with renewed youth.

examples.zh: 老街经过改造，焕发青春。
examples.en: The old street was renovated and given new life.

examples.zh: 这家老字号焕发青春，重新受到年轻人欢迎。
examples.en: The old brand has been rejuvenated and young people like it again.

usage.en: Predicate; can describe people, places or brands.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，可指人、地方、品牌。
